question: How much purse money was given to a Sangeet Natak Akademi fellow in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3 lakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Akademi Fellowship carries purse money of Rs. **3.00 lakhs**, a **Tamrapatra **and an **Angavastram**.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship is the highest honour conferred by Sangeet Natak Akademi without distinction of nationality, race, caste, religion, creed, or sex.
 
• The first Fellow of the Akademi was elected in **1954**.
 
• With the formation of the Akademi, the Awards came to be known as Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards. The Presidential Awards for **1952 and 1953 were subsequently incorporated into the list of Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr Rajendra Prasad**, the first President of India, inaugrated it on 28 January 1953.
 
• It was created by a resolution of the (then) Ministry of Education, Government of India, in 1952 with **Dr P.V. Rajamannar as its first Chairman**.
 
• The Fellowship of the Akademi is the most prestigious and rare honour, which is restricted to **40** numbers at any given time.
 
• It is presently an Autonomous Body of the Ministry of Culture, Government of India and is fully funded by the Government for the implementation of its schemes and programmes.
